title: {{name}} and the Little Star
summary: 帮坠落小星星回家(魔杖):夜里小星星坠落花园很伤心,主角用旧魔杖挥出粉光把它送回月亮天空。
text:
{{name}} is in the garden. It is night now. {{name}} sees a little star. The star is falling down! It lands by a tree.

The star is sad. "I want to go home," it says. {{name}} smiles at the star. "I can help you," says {{name}}.

There is an old wand by the tree. {{name}} picks it up. The wand is glowing! It feels warm and soft.

{{name}} waves the wand up high. Pink lights are jumping in the sky. The little star is going up now. It flies back to the moon!

The star is happy. All the stars are smiling. They make a big heart in the sky. {{name}} is happy too. What a magic night!

questions.prompt: What does {{name}} see in the garden?
What does {{name}} use to help the star?
Where does the little star go in the end?
